fixtureIdentity.description: Reserved fixture ids and reserved persona principals; anything else in a fixture-owned entity belongs to someone real.

entities.reason: Portfolio rows the suite creates on behalf of reserved personas.
entities.ownership: rows whose owner is a reserved persona AND whose id does not match the seeded-fixture id shape

entities.reason: Notes the note-authoring flow creates; the flow deletes them only on its happy path, so the reset owns the survivors.
entities.ownership: rows authored by a reserved persona and older than the in-flight window

entities.reason: Lists the watchlist flow creates with a marked name.
entities.ownership: rows whose name carries the reserved e2e marker prefix

entities.reason: Ingested catalog; measured multi-hour reload and no seed in this repo can restore it.
entities.enforcedBy: reset role holds SELECT only on the catalog schema

entities.reason: Migration-seeded reference data; clearing it does not reset the environment, it breaks it, and no seed re-runs the migration.
Recomputed from catalog and fixture rows; neither cleared nor preserved.
Money ledger; irreversible and never a reset target under any environment.
entities.enforcedBy: reset role has no grant on the ledger schema; grant revoked, not merely unused

entities.reason: Throwaway accounts registered by sign-up flows; rows are not the only kind of state.
entities.ownership: accounts whose identifier matches the reserved persona address shape

entities.reason: Files uploaded by the attachment flow under a reserved prefix.
entities.ownership: objects under the reserved e2e prefix only

entities.reason: Rebuilt from the catalog after a reset; a stale index reads as a product bug.
Dead-letter backlog from suite runs; left alone it hides the next real failure.
entities.ownership: messages whose correlation id carries the reserved e2e prefix

preserves-non-fixture-data.evidence: tests/reset/preserve.test — catalog counts unchanged across a reset

rejects-reserved-id-collision.evidence: tests/reset/identity.test — reserved id colliding with a real row aborts

rejects-foreign-references.evidence: tests/reset/references.test — fixture row referencing a preserved row is refused, not cascaded

requires-write-acknowledgment.evidence: tests/reset/acknowledgment.test — unacknowledged mutation reported as failure

converges-on-second-apply.evidence: tests/reset/converge.test — second apply reports zero further change

verifies-exact-counts.evidence: tests/reset/verify.test — exact per-entity counts, never 'at least one'

production-fails-closed.evidence: tests/reset/guard.test — every production alias refused with transport never invoked

guard-at-the-choke-point.evidence: tests/reset/guard.test — the guard runs immediately before every outbound mutation

enumerates-before-mutating.evidence: tests/reset/dry-run.test — unknown ownership blocks the run
